original_message: Rainwater came through my sunroof seal during the downpour in Pashan, Pune on 3 Feb and soaked the dashboard of my car MH12QZ4826. The display and central lock have stopped working; workshop says Rs 18,700. I sent photos, pls let me know what else to attach. The dashbord lights keep flickering.

While loading boxes at a hotel in Matheran last night, the liftgate of my hatchback MH-14-KP-6138 slammed in the wind and its hinge bent. I cut my forearm on the broken trim; the clinic cleaned it. Yaar, can you help me start the vehicle repair claim?

I had a tail-lamp repair closed in March, but this is a different job. On 9 June a heavy branch fell onto my parked car mh 09 ts 5516 outside our apartment in Banjara Hills, Hyderabad. The roof and bonnet have several dents and a side mirror is bent; the glass is intact. The building guard saw the branch fall and the vehicle had not moved. I asked the workshop for an estimate, which is approx 45000, and I can forward its photos tmrw. Acident ki paperwork ke liye please batao which documents the workshop should include for this storm-damage claim; I'm not reopening the old lamp repair.

Forwarded by my brother:
> Our car MH19 PU 2048 caught fire under the carport at home in Satara on 14/07.
That's my car. I cut my hand on the broken window while getting a bag from the back seat, and the clinic treated it. Please help me start a claim.

label.location: under the carport at home in Satara

original_message: Meri hatchback MH 03 RT 2671 ke roof aur bonnet par 2nd August ko Nagpur mein hailstorm se dents aa gaye. Workshop estimate 22k hai; claim ka form bhej do, pls.

I reversed my van MH-14-LK-7652 into a caterer's refrigerated cart at the hotel loading dock in Kochi on 18/04. The cart toppled and a worker fractured his toe; he was taken to hospitl. I need to sort out the cart repair and his medical costs; pls tell me what to send.

My car GJ 01 MS 9054 clipped a road-maintenance ladder beside the riverfront in Ahmedabad on 7 October. A worker fell and broke his ankle; his supervisor gave me the clinic slip. I need to report the damaged ladder and the worker's injury. What should I send?

The scrape from last month was already settled; this message is about a separate event on 22 May at a solar-installation yard in Alwarpet, Chennai. My car TN 07 BC 9182 rolled back from a loading bay and knocked a stack of panels to the ground, cracking one panel and bending its aluminium frame. The site manager sent photos and asked how the replacement cost can be handled. My garage is willing to inspect them, but we have not agreed on a final figure; the quote is somewhere between ₹30,000 and ₹45,000. Please let me know whether I should send the contractor's estimate or ask them to wait for an assessor. I am reporting damage to their equipement, not the earlier scrape. I copied the manager on this message and can forward the receipt tmrw; their controller unit is also scratched, so the estimate may change.

Bhai, in Jhotwara, Jaipur on 25/03 my car RJ 14 DM 4409 rolled into a neighbour's tiled garden fountain while I was parking. They sent an estimate around 18k; I did not file a police report. What should I send to help cover the repair?

I noticed my scooter MH 31 CG 4480 was gone from the locked scooter room at my office in Nagpur when my shift ended on 2026-09-11. Security checked the entry log, but it wasn't there. Please help me report the theft; policy MOT-4821650.

label.location: locked scooter room at my office in Nagpur

original_message: Aaj subah at the airport staff lot in Kochi, a colleague saw someone trying to pull the headlamp from my parked car KL 07 BC 1029; the lens cracked but the lamp is still attached. I wasn't there; what should I send to get help?
note: A colleague reports an attempted part removal as fact, so the label is theft despite the cracked lamp lens; the sender's requested claim type does not determine it.

original_message: After flash flooding on 6 May in the service lane near Vadodara, water carried my car GJ 01 AZ 3842 into a drainage channel. My passenger fractured a rib while climbing out and was taken to hospital. The insurer's assessor inspected it yesterday and declared a total loss. Policy MOT-3850106; the settlement estimate is approx 1.2 lakh. Police filed an FIR that morning. I'm attaching the inspection note and want the paperwork started; please tell me if the garage must keep the damaged vehicle until the survey photos are checked. The car is still at the workshop and my family has arranged a ride home.

The old bumper repair is closed; my car GJ 05 HN 8216 caught fire at Riverwalk Mall, Surat on 1st July. Insurer declared a write-off; policy MOT-7053184, estimate ₹3,75,000. No one was hurt; no police report filed. Garage says beyond econmic repair. Pls send the forms tmrw.

At Civil Lines, Jaipur on 14/09 I found the panoramic roof glass on my car RJ 14 AE 7785 cracked. A neighbour guessed someone might have tested the roof latch. Policy MOT-8402176; repair quote Rs 9,500. Nobody was hurt and I did not file a police report. How do I start a repair claim?
note: The neighbour only speculates about the roof latch; the confirmed damage is glass, so glass_only follows the guide's stated facts.

original_message: Meri hatchback MH 12 PA 8843 ka rear windshield 28 March ko Koregaon Park, Pune mein crack mila. Parking attendant ko lagta hai kisi ne boot latch check kiya, par usne kuch dekha nahi. Policy MOT-5198642; repair Rs 12,000. No one was injured; no police complaint filed. Claim ka process bata do.
note: The attendant is only speculating about the boot latch; the confirmed damage is glass, so glass_only follows the guide's stated facts.
